create.label: Add icon
create.error: The icon could not be added.

delete.label: Delete icon
delete.error: The icon could not be deleted.
delete.confirm: Should the icon really be deleted?

update.label: Edit icon configuration
update.error: The icon could not be saved.

okey.label: ID
okey.helper: A unique identifier in the form of a word. Only lowercase letters, numbers and _ or - may be used.

name.label: Icon name
name.helper: The name of the icon, e.g. pdf, doc etc. (see assets/icons or ionic).
name.menu: The icon on the menu entry (ion-icon).
name.error: The name of the icon is mandatory and must consist of alphanumeric characters.

type.label: Icon set
type.helper: Groups icons into a similar theme (e.g. Logos, Filetypes, Sections). Corresponds to the name of the subfolder in the Logo directory in Storage.

fullPath.label: Storage Path
fullPath.helper: The path to the icon in Storage.

size.label: Size
size.helper: The size of the icon in pixels, e.g. 24, 32, 48 etc.
size.error: The size of the icon must be an integer consisting only of digits.

slot.label: Icon position
slot.helper: The position of the icon in relation to the text, e.g. left, right, top, bottom. With none, only the icon is shown.
